title: Refractive, Topographic, and Aberrometric Results at 2-Year Follow-Up for Accelerated Corneal Cross-Link for Progressive Keratoconus

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution License); public

groups.description: Epithelium-off accelerated riboflavin-UVA cross-linking (30 mW/cm2 for 4 min, 7.2 J/cm2) for progressive mild-to-moderate keratoconus (Amsler-Krumeich grades I-II); 47 eyes of 41 patients; single-arm retrospective chart review without a comparison arm (role control). Same-session cataract surgery is not mentioned (combined null).

series.notes: mean ± SD as printed; corrected distance visual acuity assessed with ETDRS logMAR charts (Methods); per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: Lines of CDVA gained or lost at 24 months (Results text, Figure 1)
exclusions.reason: lines gained and proportions are not admissible (protocol inclusion 4)
uncorrected acuity is not admissible (notes only)

notes: Retrospective chart review of 47 eyes of 41 patients (some patients contributed both eyes); preoperative exclusion criteria only (pachymetry, Kmax above 65 D, previous ocular surgery, scars, herpetic keratitis, coexisting ocular pathology, systemic conditions); no minimum follow-up criterion is stated; visits at baseline and 1, 6, 12 and 24 months.
Uncorrected acuity, sphere and cylinder, keratometry and central corneal thickness (Table 1) and corneal wavefront aberrations (Table 2) are tabulated: notes only.
Extracted under extraction protocol 1.0.0, the extraction brief and addendum 1 (development extractor D5).
